turns.content: Hi, I'm the AIowa Service Guide, an AI assistant. What would you like help with?

Hi Olivia, I run uh Copper Mesa Supply. We're a plumbing supply business. We have 6 staff handling quote requests arriving by email. They copy details in Excel, but some requests get missed and we want help collecting details and preparing draft quotes. A person must approve every quote before it reaches a customer.
How would you guys help with that?

I can explain the documented workflow, but I don't have approved information confirming whether your specific email-to-Excel quote process is supported. I can say that AIowa Agents is positioned to help with repetitive business workflows like collecting details from incoming requests and preparing drafts for human review, with a person approving before anything reaches a customer. I can't confirm the exact integration with your email system or Excel setup without more approved detail. Would you like me to note your question about email and Excel support for a human review?
Yeah, please prepare that information for a human review. Don't send anything.
The selected details are retained as proposals pending owner review. Nothing has been sent or approved.
Uh, one correction, 4 staff handle those requests, not 6. We also use the supplier portal, but I don't know whether it has an API.

Thanks—that changes my understanding from 6 staff to 4 staff handling those requests. I’ve noted the supplier portal as a relevant tool, and I can’t confirm whether it has an API without approved information. Would you like me to include that API question in the human-review note as well?
Yeah, please update the existing handoff with those corrections. Uh, keeping the other details.
